name: Adam Bruno
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 4

items.text: Adam Bruno is a therapist who says he attended community college and has counseled children, adults and families. He says his top priorities are increasing enrollment, expanding access, and supporting educators. He would explore student stipends, seek donations to help students, and improve outreach and counseling. He says he is also looking into how to protect students against ICE raids.
